name: /start
description: Start a collection in this server and receive three Common eggs. Open /incubators to hatch them.
notes: You begin with ten incubators and a 5 × 5 plot. Running /start again opens your existing profile.

name: /incubators
description: Start waiting eggs, check their timers and collect the creatures that are ready to hatch.
notes: Choose Egg storage to start a particular egg. Timers keep running offline. Finished eggs occupy their slots until collected. Last hatch results reopens your latest batch.

name: /help
description: Open a private overview of egg tiers, hatch times and the first steps for building your plot.

name: /guide
description: Open the private in-game command guide. Choose a category and a command to see its arguments and how to use it.

name: /inventory
description: Browse the animals in storage. Inspect individual copies, compare their earnings, mark favourites, place animals or review a sale.

options.name: search
options.description: Part of a stored animal’s name. Leave blank to view all stored animals.

notes: Use the menu to sort by name, value or income, filter by rarity or favourites, and sell several copies at once. Sell duplicates keeps one of each species.

name: /collection
description: Open your permanent discovery journal. Find silhouettes of undiscovered species and inspect the lore and stats of animals you have found.

options.name: search
options.description: A rarity or part of a discovered species name. Leave blank to browse the full journal.

notes: A discovery stays in the journal after you sell or trade away the animal. You can review hatch counts, plot income ranges and base hatch odds here.

name: /sell
description: Choose one owned animal, review its Shellbit sale price and confirm the sale.

options.name: creature_name
options.description: Select the copy to sell from the suggestions. Each lists its income and copy label or plot coordinates.

notes: An animal reserved for an active trade must be released from that offer first. Selling keeps the species in your discovery journal.

name: /plot view
description: Open your plot and minimap. Move the 5 × 5 view, check earnings or select a visible animal to return to storage.
notes: Each axis runs from 0 to 29. Your starting land spans 12 through 16 on both axes.

name: /place
description: Place an animal from storage on an empty tile you own so it starts earning Shellbits.

options.name: creature_name
options.description: An animal in your inventory. Choose a particular copy from the suggestions if you own several.

options.name: x
options.description: Horizontal tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

options.name: y
options.description: Vertical tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

notes: This is the shortcut for /plot place. An animal held in an active trade must be released first.

name: /plot place
description: Move a stored animal onto an empty, unlocked tile. Its individual hourly income starts counting towards your plot earnings.

options.name: creature_name
options.description: An animal in your inventory. Choose a particular copy from the suggestions if you own several.

options.name: x
options.description: Horizontal tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

options.name: y
options.description: Vertical tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

notes: Each tile holds one animal. To move one that is already placed, use /plot remove first.

name: /plot remove
description: Return a placed animal to your inventory. Its copy keeps its hourly rate for the next time you place it.

options.name: creature_name
options.description: Choose an animal on your plot. Suggestions show the plot coordinates and hourly rate of each copy.

name: /plot expand
description: Review the Shellbit price and confirm the purchase of a locked tile that shares an edge with your land.

options.name: x
options.description: Horizontal tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

options.name: y
options.description: Vertical tile coordinate, a whole number from 0 to 29.

notes: Your first expansion costs 200 SB. Each tile you buy adds 25 SB to the price of the next one.

name: /plot collect
description: Move the Shellbits earned by your placed animals into your wallet. The bot sends the amount to you privately.
notes: Plot income continues while you are away, with up to 12 hours credited for an uninterrupted absence.

name: /rank
description: Review the next rank and its price. Confirm an upgrade with Shellbits to claim the next wild egg tier and unlock five more incubators.
notes: Ranks are purchased in order. Eternal Ascendant opens Eternal egg claims and brings your capacity to 50 incubators.

name: /quest
description: Open your private board of three daily and three weekly quests. Refresh your progress, then use each completed quest’s Claim button.
notes: Rewards include Shellbits and eggs. Claim them before the daily reset at 00:00 UTC or the weekly reset on Monday at 00:00 UTC.

name: /daily
description: Claim 1,000 Shellbits and one Common egg. The next claim becomes available 24 hours later.
notes: You need one free egg storage slot. The reward egg appears in /incubators.

name: /weekly
description: Claim 5,000 Shellbits and one Uncommon egg. The next claim becomes available seven days later.
notes: You need one free egg storage slot. The reward egg appears in /incubators.

name: /monthly
description: Claim 20,000 Shellbits and one Rare egg. The next claim becomes available 30 days later.
notes: You need one free egg storage slot. The reward egg appears in /incubators.

name: /shop
description: Browse 50 luck and incubator items, buy them with Shellbits and activate them from My item bag. Open Cosmetics to buy or equip a profile design.
notes: Buying a consumable adds it to your bag. Luck affects new wild egg claims, speed affects eggs you start, and timer items reduce the time left on running incubators.

name: /profile view
description: Display a collector card showing progress and equipped cosmetics for you or another player in this server.

options.name: player
options.description: Choose a server member who has started playing. Leave blank for your own card.

name: /profile customize
description: Set a rank title, feature a discovered species or use its portrait as your avatar. With no options, this opens the avatar picker.

options.name: title
options.description: An unlocked rank title. Leave blank to keep your current title.

options.name: creature_name
options.description: A species from your permanent journal to feature on your card. Leave blank to keep your current selection.

options.name: avatar
options.description: A species from your permanent journal to use as your portrait. Leave blank to keep your current avatar.

notes: The picker also lets you switch back to your Discord avatar.

name: /trade
description: Invite another player in this server to trade creatures and Shellbits. Omit the player to reopen your active trade.

options.name: player
options.description: Choose another human member who has used /start in this server. Leave blank to resume an invitation or trade.

notes: Each player can join one trade at a time. Offers allow up to 25 unfavourited animals from storage and expire after ten minutes. Both players must confirm again after either offer changes.

name: /casino rules
description: Read the rules, odds and payouts for coinflip, slots and blackjack in a private message.
notes: New games are available only in channels where the server has enabled them. Stakes use fictional Shellbits. There is a five-second cooldown between new games.

name: /casino coinflip
description: Choose Heads or Tails and place a Shellbit bet in an enabled channel. A correct call returns 1.9 times your stake.

options.name: bet
options.description: A whole-number stake from 10 to 10,000 fictional Shellbits, in multiples of 10.

options.name: choice
options.description: Choose Heads or Tails. Both are equally likely.

notes: Payouts include the stake. An incorrect call returns zero.

name: /casino slots
description: Spin three reels in an enabled channel. Three matching symbols return 18 times the stake, and exactly one pair returns 1.45 times the stake.

options.name: bet
options.description: A whole-number stake from 10 to 10,000 fictional Shellbits, in multiples of 10.

notes: Each reel has seven equally likely symbols. No match returns zero. Returns include the stake and round down to whole Shellbits.

name: /casino blackjack
description: Start a blackjack hand in an enabled channel. Hit, stand or double down on your first two cards.

options.name: bet
options.description: A whole-number stake from 10 to 10,000 fictional Shellbits, in multiples of 10.

notes: The dealer stands on all 17s. A natural pays 3:2, a regular win pays 1:1, and a tie returns the stake. Your hand stands automatically after three minutes.

name: /casino resume
description: Reopen your most recent blackjack hand. Continue a live hand or review the outcome if it has already ended.
notes: An expired hand settles as a stand. A saved hand can still be finished if new bets have been disabled in that channel.
